title: Calloway Limited Home Warranty Coverage Held on More Than One Home
content:
A homeowner may hold Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage on any number of Calloway homes they own; there is no cap on the number of coverages per customer. Coverage always belongs to one home, and the home is identified by the purchase agreement under which Calloway sold it.

| Question | Answer under this rule |
|---|---|
| Is there a limit on how many homes one homeowner may hold coverage on? | No; the number of coverages per customer is uncapped. |
| To what does a coverage belong? | To one home. |
| What identifies that home? | The purchase agreement under which Calloway sold it. |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A homeowner who owns two Calloway homes, each sold under its own purchase agreement, holds two separate coverages, one on each home; each coverage is tied to the purchase agreement of its own home.
